entity.name: Ryoma Hori
entity.description: Full-stack developer building Quira Browser, a local-first Gecko-based browser with AI-powered context graph.

projects.name: Quira Browser
projects.description: A local-first, Gecko-based browser that builds a personal context graph from browsing activity, enabling users to query their own browsing history with natural language. All processing happens on-device with zero cloud dependency.

plans.name: Core Development
plans.description: Gecko fork setup, context graph engine, on-device LLM integration, browser UI, and WebExtension API development.
